mentions.name: bbkane's dotfiles repo
mentions.description: A dotfiles repository where each tool gets its own subdirectory containing a README that documents that tool's dependencies and keyboard shortcuts. The per-tool layout is designed to stay resilient against changing needs, operating systems, and tool versions, prioritizing easy configuration of the latest subset of tools on a new PC over a single one-shot setup script.
mentions.problem: Tool usage changes enough that fully configuring every tool on a new PC is not worth maintaining; only the latest subset of tools matters.
mentions.source_excerpt: To that end, each tool has its own subdirectory in my dotfiles repo ( https://github.com/bbkane/dotfiles/ ), and I add READMEs to each subdirectory explaining what dependencies are necessary for this tool, what keyboard shortcuts this tool uses, etc.
